functions.name: afind
functions.done: Slides a window over each text, finds the best-matching substring for each pattern, and returns location, distance, and optional match matrices.

check.case: running_cosine q=3, osa, UTF-8 bytes, NA, multi-pattern, jw, hamming, cosine, and value FALSE

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path[:0] = ["/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/stringdist"]
from stringdist.afind import afind


def column_major(mat):
    if not mat:
        return []
    nrow = len(mat)
    ncol = len(mat[0])
    out = []
    for j in range(ncol):
        for i in range(nrow):
            out.append(mat[i][j])
    return out


def numeric_part(result):
    return column_major(result["location"]) + column_major(result["distance"])


def one():
    texts = [
        "When I grow up, I want to be",
        "one of the harvesters of the sea",
        "I think before my days are gone",
        "I want to be a fisherman",
    ]
    patterns = ["fish", "gone", "to be"]
    parts = [
        numeric_part(afind(texts, patterns, method="running_cosine", q=3)),
        numeric_part(afind("abcabc", "bc", method="osa")),
        numeric_part(afind("aaaa", "aa", method="osa")),
        numeric_part(afind("Motörhead", "tor", useBytes=True, method="osa")),
        numeric_part(afind("Motörhead", "tor", useBytes=False, method="osa")),
        numeric_part(afind([None, "abc"], "bc", method="osa")),
        numeric_part(afind("abcdef", ["bc", "de"], method="osa")),
        numeric_part(afind("survey", "surgery", method="jw", p=0.1)),
        numeric_part(afind("ab", "ba", method="hamming")),
        numeric_part(afind("abc", "cba", method="cosine", q=2)),
        numeric_part(
            afind(texts, patterns, method="running_cosine", q=3, value=False)
        ),
    ]
    out = []
    for part in parts:
        out.extend(part)
    return out


def fmt(value):
    if value is None:
        return "null"
    if value != value:
        return '"NaN"'
    if value == float("inf"):
        return '"Inf"'
    if value == float("-inf"):
        return '"-Inf"'
    return format(float(value), ".17g")


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
text = ",".join(fmt(item) for item in value)
print('{"value":[%s],"median_ms":%.17g}' % (text, statistics.median(elapsed)))

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path[:0] = ["/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/stringdist"]
from stringdist.grab import grab


def one():
    texts = [
        "When I grow up, I want to be",
        "one of the harvesters of the sea",
        "I think before my days are gone",
        "I want to be a fisherman",
    ]
    idx = [
        float(i)
        for i in (
            grab(texts, "fish", maxDist=0.5)
            + grab(texts, "gone", maxDist=float("inf"))
            + grab(texts, "grew", maxDist=1)
            + grab("abcabc", "bc", maxDist=0)
            + grab("abcabc", "bc", maxDist=1)
            + grab([None, "abc"], "bc", maxDist=1)
            + grab("Motörhead", "tor", useBytes=True, maxDist=2, method="osa")
            + grab("abcdef", "bcd", method="lv", maxDist=1)
            + grab("ab", "ba", method="hamming", maxDist=2)
            + grab("abc", "cba", method="cosine", q=2, maxDist=1)
        )
    ]
    strings = grab(texts, "fish", maxDist=0.5, value=True) + grab(
        texts, "to be", method="running_cosine", q=3, maxDist=0.2, value=True
    )
    return {"idx": idx, "strings": strings}


def fmt_num(value):
    if value is None:
        return "null"
    if value != value:
        return '"NaN"'
    if value == float("inf"):
        return '"Inf"'
    if value == float("-inf"):
        return '"-Inf"'
    return format(float(value), ".17g")


result = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
num_text = ",".join(fmt_num(item) for item in result["idx"])
str_text = ",".join(json.dumps(item) for item in result["strings"])
print(
    '{"value":[%s],"strings":[%s],"median_ms":%.17g}'
    % (num_text, str_text, statistics.median(elapsed))
)

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))
if (packageDescription("stringdist")$Version != "0.9.17") stop("expected stringdist 0.9.17")
options(sd_num_thread = 1L)

one <- function() {
  ouml <- intToUtf8(0x00F6)
  x <- c("Motorhead", paste0("Mot", ouml, "rhead"))
  parts <- list(
    printable_ascii(x),
    printable_ascii("abc\r"),
    printable_ascii(NA_character_),
    printable_ascii(c(NA_character_, "abc")),
    printable_ascii(c(NA, "abc")),
    printable_ascii(character(0)),
    printable_ascii("\t"),
    printable_ascii("hello\tworld"),
    printable_ascii(""),
    printable_ascii(c("", " ", "A", "!")),
    printable_ascii("Mot\u00f6rhead"),
    printable_ascii("abc\n"),
    printable_ascii("ASCII only 123"),
    printable_ascii(" !\"#$%&'()*+,./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~-"),
    printable_ascii(c("Robert", "rupert", "Rubin")),
    printable_ascii(paste0("\r", "hello")),
    printable_ascii(paste0("hello", "\r"))
  )
  as.numeric(unlist(parts, use.names = FALSE))
}

  if (is.nan(v)) return('"NaN"')

functions.name: seq_dist
functions.done: Pairwise distances between integer sequences, using stringdist on the codes.

check.case: Pairwise distances of integer sequences across methods, recycling, NA, and a match against stringdist on word pairs

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))
if (packageDescription("stringdist")$Version != "0.9.17") stop("expected stringdist 0.9.17")
options(sd_num_thread = 1L)

one <- function() {
  words <- c("ca", "abc", "MARTHA", "MATHRA", "survey", "surgery", "leia", "leela")
  cross <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(4L)) {
    left <- words[[i]]
    right <- words[[i + 1L]]
    cross <- c(
      cross,
      seq_dist(list(utf8ToInt(left)), list(utf8ToInt(right)), method = "osa"),
      stringdist(left, right, method = "osa"),
      as.numeric(amatch(left, right, maxDist = 100, method = "osa"))
    )
  }
  c(
    seq_dist(list(c(1L, 1L, 2L)), list(c(1L, 2L, 1L), c(2L, 3L, 1L, 2L))),
    seq_dist(a = list(c(1L, 2L, 3L)), b = list(c(2L, 1L, 3L)), method = "osa"),
    seq_dist(a = list(c(1L, 2L, 3L)), b = list(c(2L, 1L, 3L)), method = "lv"),
    seq_dist(a = list(c(2L, 1L)), b = list(c(1L, 3L, 2L)), method = "dl"),
    seq_dist(a = list(c(1L, 2L, 3L)), b = list(c(1L, 0L, 3L)), method = "hamming"),

    seq_dist(a = list(c(1L, 2L, 3L)), b = list(c(1L, 0L, 3L)), method = "qgram", q = 2),
    seq_dist(a = list(c(1L, 2L, 3L)), b = list(c(1L, 0L, 3L)), method = "cosine", q = 2),
    seq_dist(a = list(c(1L, 2L, 3L)), b = list(c(1L, 0L, 3L)), method = "jaccard", q = 2),
    round(
      1 - seq_dist(
        list(utf8ToInt("martha")),
        list(utf8ToInt("marhta")),
        method = "jw"

      3

    seq_dist(c(1, 2, 3), c(2, 3, 4)),

]

def column_major(mat):
    if not mat:
        return []
    nrow = len(mat)
    ncol = len(mat[0])
    out = []
    for j in range(ncol):
        for i in range(nrow):
            out.append(mat[i][j])
    return out


def one():
    parts = [
        column_major(seq_distmatrix(short, short[1:4], method="osa")),
        column_major(
            seq_distmatrix(
                short,
                short[1:4],
                method="dl",
                weight=(0.5, 0.8, 0.3, 0.4),
            )
        ),
        column_major(seq_distmatrix(short, short[1:4], method="jw", p=0.1)),
        column_major(seq_distmatrix(short, short[1:4], method="cosine", q=2)),
        column_major(

        ),

                [[1, 2, 3]],
                method="osa",
            )
        ),
    ]
    out = []
    for part in parts:

    if value == float("-inf"):
